articles.title: Federal Judge Declines to Halt Trump’s Executive Order on Mail-In Voting—For Now
articles.summary: A D.C. federal judge ruled it’s too early to block Trump’s order that could restrict mail-in voting, since agencies haven’t acted yet. Opponents call it voter suppression and vow to keep fighting, as another Boston case looms.

articles.title: Latvia Installs New PM After Drone Incidents Topple Coalition
articles.summary: Latvia’s parliament confirmed Andris Kulbergs as prime minister after the previous government collapsed over its handling of stray Ukrainian drones. The new coalition vows to bolster security and maintain a pro-NATO, pro-EU course.

articles.title: Inflation Hits 3.8%, Highest in Three Years, as Americans’ Spending Power Erodes
articles.summary: A key inflation gauge surged to 3.8% in April, driven by gas, food, and services. After-tax incomes fell for the third straight month, and consumer spending barely budged. The Fed may hike rates, adding pressure on households ahead of midterms.
